checks: The exact lengths give the base barycenter 316/211. Normalization fixes ell_b at one there, and the two endpoint inequalities yield [−211/317,211/316]. Both interior samples have strictly positive ell throughout this closed interval, including its endpoints.

Nonnegativity and arithmetic normalization imply ell_b(p)V_p≤M for every sample. Since E_p≤V_p and Sigma<1, every shift is at most epsilon, including a zero multiplier at an extreme site. On each inner neighborhood, positivity of its factor permits differentiation; ell_b(p)/M≤1/V_p, E_i>1, |E_i'|<1 and V_i>1 give |delta_i'|<epsilon/2. Thus the exact calibration's hypotheses hold uniformly over the parameter interval.

The calibration applies to the identical four actual fibers with their unchanged original lengths, same two source marks and same shift convention. It gives Q plus the larger of the two shifts, and its exact maximizer set transfers for every b.

Independent Fraction arithmetic gives b=14137/108948 from the intersection equation, verifies strict interiority, and reproduces all four displayed factors and the common product 53383/27237. The first product decreases strictly, the second increases strictly, and the square root and positive epsilon preserve order. Hence there is exactly one minimizer and both marks are its only maximizing sources.

The two weights 2−bar g and bar g−1 are positive, sum to one, and give bar g from bases 1 and 2. Source 3101206ec4580190 §6 and source 1298c8ea2c6ec3df §§1–3 support these exact statements. The minimax does not invoke the general contact or derivative theory of the earlier sections.
